description: Search the San Francisco open-data catalogue (data.sfgov.org, also written data.sf.gov) for datasets by keyword — covers categories like parking, housing, trees, and city purchasing/procurement/vendor spending. Returns dataset names, descriptions, and Socrata resource ids to use with sf_query.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

name: sf_datasets
